## Summary

Describe the change and its user-visible effect.

## Validation

- [ ] `dart format --output=none --set-exit-if-changed lib test example/lib`
- [ ] `flutter analyze`
- [ ] `flutter test`
- [ ] Relevant native example build(s)
- [ ] Documentation and changelog updated when required

## Security and privacy

- [ ] Speech recognition remains fully on-device.
- [ ] This change does not reduce application security or user privacy.

Pull requests that decrease application security or privacy will be declined.
